method: Selected official vendor release/news pages, model/API changelogs, API model and pricing pages, and selected model-serving provider announcement histories. The inventory is bounded; absence from checked pages is not proof that no announcement exists globally.
temporal_handling: Publisher date, page date, checked time, planned availability and price effective date are separate. Never infer a timezone for date-only pages.

selected_items.finding: Official article describes Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed as available on Kimi.com, mobile apps, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and Kimi API; describes the model as 3T-class and gives a 1M-token context window; says full weights are planned by Nov 4, 2026.
limitations: The official index gives only a date, not an hour or timezone; chronology relative to the previous issue cutoff and the target 08:00 JST checkpoint cannot be confirmed.
Availability and speed statements are provider claims, not independent tests.
The checked pages did not establish regional API availability or license terms for future weights.

selected_items.finding: Official research index dates Kimi K3.1 Pro to 2026-10-24.
limitations: Date-only display; no timezone or posting time.

selected_items.finding: Confirms API IDs kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed, 1M-token context, minimum CNY 10 top-up for access, CNY 15 new-user coupon not applicable, and usage limits vary with cumulative top-ups.
limitations: The page does not establish a region-wide availability promise.

selected_items.finding: At the checked time the listing displays standard Pro at CNY 13 input/CNY 68 output per MTok and Highspeed at CNY 26 input/CNY 136 output per MTok; cache-write prices CNY 13/CNY 26 and cache-hit price CNY 1.30 for both.
limitations: The listing has no effective date; figures are recorded as displayed at check time and are not currency-converted.

scope_limits: This is not a census of all AI announcements.
Date-only Kimi sources cannot be ordered against the previous issue cutoff or the scheduled 08:00 JST target cutoff.
Model/API prices were recorded in the currencies and units displayed; no conversion was performed.
Performance, speed, safety and benchmark statements are provider claims unless explicitly identified as independent external evaluation.
No model-weight license or region-wide API availability was confirmed from the selected Kimi sources.
